description: The Bank of Japan's current policy interest rate for JAPAN (the BOJ short-term policy rate / Monetary Policy-Related Interest Rate, % per annum). Returns the latest value, its month, and recent monthly history. Use this for any 'Bank of Japan interest rate' / 'BOJ rate' / 'Japan policy rate' question. Sourced from IMF IFS (keyless). As of mid-2026 the rate is 0.5% (BOJ exited negative rates in 2024 and hiked to 0.5% in Jan 2025).

months.description: How many recent months of history to return (default 12).

name: boj_policy_rate
title: Boj Policy Rate
